_comment: Selective quality gate, NOT a CI gate (test-plan §5). Coverage says a line ran; mutation score says a test would fail if the line were broken. Run it narrowly after a risk phase and resolve each survivor by asking whether the change would hurt a user or the business: npx stryker run --mutate "src/lib/services/credits.ts". `mutate` is deliberately left at Stryker's default glob, which already excludes *.test.ts, so colocated tests need no ignore entry.
